# Content hash determinism and order independence

ir.content_hash must produce identical output for semantically equivalent inputs regardless of key order, and must change for input with different ordering of list contents.

Provide a stable, content-addressable representation so downstream systems can rely on deterministic hashes for caching, deduplication, or comparison.
